title: Contact — Sephiria Guide
description: Contact sephiria-guide.com about a Football Manager 27 page or a Sephiria page: corrections, broken install paths, missing files, advertising.
meta: Unofficial fan guide · Not affiliated with Team Horay or Sports Interactive · Last updated: 2026-11-13
body:
Email: jeromell@be-winner.com. This is a one-person fan site covering two games, so the same address handles both sections — say which page you mean and the message lands in the right place.

What to write about

The site has a Football Manager 27 section and a Sephiria section. Both kinds of report are useful:

If the page isSend
An FM27 install or mod pageThe page URL, your platform (Steam / Epic / Game Pass / Steam Deck), the folder you used, and what the game did. A screenshot of the folder tree is worth more than a description.
An FM27 page quoting a version or a dateThe maintainer's page showing a newer release, so the version line can be updated.
A Sephiria unlock or mechanic pageThe page URL, the sentence that is wrong, what you saw in-game instead, and a patch note or dated guide that can be re-checked.
Any page with a broken linkThe page you started from and the link that failed. External maintainer pages move often; a dead download link is worth reporting.
Anything about advertising or a privacy questionSent to the same address. There is no account system, so there is no account data to delete.

What to expect

Mail is read by one person, best effort. There is no ticket system and no response-time promise; corrections are handled in batches when pages are next revised. If a fix checks out, the page is edited and its checked-date moves to the new date. If a report cannot be verified, the page keeps its hedge rather than switching to an unconfirmed claim — that is deliberate, and it is why some FM27 pages say “the author does not state a build”.

If you need an answer tonight, the game's own sources are faster than a site update: for FM27 that is the maintainer's support thread on the download page, and for Sephiria it is the in-game Journal and the Steam discussions.

What is out of scope

  • Cheats, trainers, save editing, piracy, and requests to host mod files. None of it is supported or linked here.
  • Account, refund, ban or purchase problems — those belong to Steam, Epic, Microsoft, Netflix or Apple, and for FM27 also to SEGA Support.
  • Requests to play a run, carry a lobby or review a build for you.
  • Paid placements, sponsored posts and link exchanges. Ads are served by Google AdSense and placements are not for sale.

How email is handled

Messages are used to reply or to fix a page. There is no newsletter and no mailing list, so nothing is signed up on your behalf. If a correction leads to an edit, the change may be described on the page in general terms; your name is not attached unless you ask for it.

Before writing, check the page's Sources list and its checked-date. A figure that disagrees with an older guide is often two different game builds rather than an error — the editorial policy explains how that is handled.

See also About and Privacy.
